findings.text: Defect 1 is neither reproduced nor fixed: _pending_projection_stub_predicate carries the same clauses as the base predicate at c59ac227a:1010-1036, so the five named stubs still fail with 'has non-bindable name_stage pending' and the node's fragment states 'No production composition result is claimed'. The coordinator's resume-3 advice deferred this ('Do not chase the original adoption cause'), so the finding records that the stated node goal is undelivered rather than that the repair was unknown to the coordinator.

Three of the four cases the brief required to fail on main pass on the base arm: test_two_path_projection_stub_is_adopted (:212), test_structural_parent_projection_stub_is_adopted (:226) and test_stolen_claim_aborts_transaction (:477); unit-base-graph.log fails only test_*second_claim_after_unpark_finalizes*, so the adoption and stolen-claim cases are regression coverage rather than the main-failing controls the done_when asks for.

test_rich_write_then_adoption_keeps_the_ownership_guard asserts that a rich write followed by an adoption attempt yields winners == [] and leaves the stub pending, which pins the exact refusal that keeps the five stubs from composing; it must be revisited in the scoped compose the coordinator now owns, because a fix that lets the claimed source's own producer be adopted will make this test fail.
